summary: Full backend + UI regression on Group 1 (Notification Template Editor + Applicant/Member Messaging). 21/21 pytest cases pass (1 skipped: no application without an email on record to trigger 400). All 9 templates present, list/get/preview/update/test-send/404/400 branches verified. /api/comms preview + send + history verified for email, portal, and both channels, plus invalid channel/subject/body/subject_type 400s. UI: /portal/templates renders 9 cards grouped by category with Auto/Manual badges, preview dialog shows rendered HTML with sample context, edit dialog saves and test-send to delivered@resend.dev succeeds. Application detail Communications tab loads CommsPanel, template select auto-fills subject/body via /comms/preview, Email+Portal channel sends and appears in history (newest first) with template chip and Sent status. No blocking issues found.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description — a11y warning in console; non-blocking

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Send Message, template Preview, and template Edit dialogs to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3128 lines — consider splitting into modules (notifications, comms, applications, events) for maintainability.

/api/comms only refreshes status from email_log for rows that have email_log_id; that's correct. However the initial insert stores status from log['status'] which is already 'sent'/'failed'; delivered/opened rely on Resend webhooks (documented).
TemplateUpdate accepts partial updates but does not sanitize empty strings; sending subject='' would overwrite. Not blocking (only leadership can edit) but consider min_length validation.

administrator role blocking on PUT was NOT tested end-to-end (no admin session available in this env). Backend uses require_roles(*LEADERSHIP_ROLES) which excludes 'administrator' per code inspection; the branch is verified by code review only.
test_credentials: Authorization: Bearer tok_admtest (super_admin). Cookie session_token=tok_admtest for portal.
seed_data_creation: Ran /app/backend/tests/seed_badge.py to guarantee admin session + seeded events/regs/applications.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Group 1 (templates + comms) endpoints and UI are stable. Reusable pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_group1_comms_templates.py. Use application id from GET /api/applications?limit=1 for comms tests. Use to=delivered@resend.dev for successful test-sends. Admin session token tok_admtest.
